summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an investor presentation with second quarter 2026 results. The presentation contains routine financial disclosures, forward-looking statements, and non-U.S. GAAP reconciliation discussions. No M&A, tender offer, buyback, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. This is a standard earnings/results communication by a foreign private issuer.
